Provenance of the NF3e test files in this folder

Source: akretion/nfelib (https://github.com/akretion/nfelib, MIT License, commit 7082879710d1400db31e0baa435a0506355e940f)

nf3e.xml
  Derived from: nfelib/nf3e/samples/v1_0/nota_energia-nf3e.xml
  Changes:
  - anonymised: CNPJs 42124473000199 / 98765432000188 -> 99999999000191 / 88888888000191, CPF -> 12345678909;
    company/consumer names, trade name, addresses, CEP, IE, e-mails, phone, GPS coordinates and gRespTec contact
    replaced by obvious test values
  - recomputed access key (mod 11 cDV) and Id; qrCodNF3e rebuilt with the new key
  - tabs replaced by 2-space indentation
- appended a dummy, structurally valid ICP-Brasil xmldsig <Signature> (fixed c14n/rsa-sha1/sha1 algorithm URIs, Reference URI="#<Id>", dummy base64 DigestValue/SignatureValue/X509Certificate; no real certificate)

nf3e-proc.xml
  Built from nf3e.xml wrapped into <nf3eProc versao="1.00"> plus a synthetic <protNF3e versao="1.00">
- protocol (infProt) is synthetic: tpAmb 2, verAplic SVRS-TESTE-1.0, dummy nProt/digVal, cStat 100, xMotivo "Autorizado o uso da NF3e"
